sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:69

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:69:1
items.html: And Yaakov is a chariot to the six externals, and Moshe to the internality — this one from within and this one from without. This was explained above in the words of the ARI, page 899, item 52, and page 902, items 59 and 60: that Moshe merited the posterior of the upper Bina, which is the secret of four times thirty combinations of Elokim, and the posterior of Tevuna, which are five times twenty-four combinations; and the Tevuna is externality and the Bina is internality. And this is what he says, that Yaakov merited the externality, namely the posterior of Tevuna that clothe in ZA; and Moshe merited the internality, namely the posterior of the upper Bina that clothe in ZA. And see page 901, the passage beginning “and this is what he says, Moshe.”
